needsBespoke.why: Kayn's form system (Rhaast vs Shadow Assassin) is not a simple buff/stack but permanently overwrites the damage formulas of Q, W and R with entirely different scalings (e.g. Q switches from 195+85%bonusAD physical damage to 65%AD + 6%(+3.5%/100 bonusAD) of target max HP per hit as Rhaast; W loses its cast time and gains 200 range as Shadow Assassin), so a correct simulation needs to pick one form and apply a coherent set of overridden ability values rather than compose the closed-list primitives on top of a single base kit. Additionally the passive Shadow Assassin Bonus is a self-referential %-of-post-mitigation-damage-dealt amplifier that reads the very damage instance that triggers it (including the triggering hit itself) and needs custom sequencing logic beyond a generic conditional-damage or timed-self-buff primitive.

proposal: Open with Reaping Slash (Q): dash through the dummy then swing, landing two separate physical damage instances.
Follow immediately with Blade's Reach (W) on cooldown for another physical damage instance (no cast time if Shadow Assassin form is assumed).

Once Q or W has damaged the target (marking it for R), cast Umbral Trespass (R): channel briefly then recast as soon as legally possible to land its physical (or Rhaast max-HP) damage and, if Shadow Assassin, reset Q's cooldown on emerge.
Fill all remaining time with basic attacks between ability casts.
Recast Q and W again as soon as their cooldowns and mana allow; recast R again once its long cooldown (80-120s) comes up (likely only once in a 15s fight).
Do not cast Shadow Step (E): it deals no damage to the dummy and only serves defensive/mobility purposes.
